provenance.description: What each metric's pre-computed baseline counts, restated in our own notation from the Malachite baseline SQL. No SQL is copied. observed_filter / observed_agg are the YARA-L event predicates and outcome aggregation that select the same events on the observed (today) side.
provenance.source_snapshot: read 2026-09-30 from CitC workspace sync_secops_risk_metrics; config.textproto @ CL 966654211
provenance.enum_source: googlex/security/malachite/proto/external/udm.proto (proto3): SecurityResult.Action UNKNOWN_ACTION=0, ALLOW=1; EventType USER_LOGIN=15001, PROCESS_LAUNCH=10001, RESOURCE_CREATION=1, RESOURCE_DELETION=2, RESOURCE_READ=4, RESOURCE_WRITTEN=5, USER_RESOURCE_CREATION=15009, USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_CONTENT=15010, USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS=15013, USER_RESOURCE_DELETION=15014
provenance.consistency_check: For every metric the non-dimension part of the WHERE clause is identical across all of its <dimensions>.sql files.
search_semantics: UDM is proto3. 'X IS NOT NULL' on a scalar inside a sub-message is true whenever the sub-message is present (unset scalars read as 0 / ""), so it means 'message present', not 'field set'.

UDM Search cannot match the enum default: security_result.action = "UNKNOWN_ACTION" returns 0 rows on gus-sdl while grouping by action reports UNKNOWN_ACTION for logins that carry no action. Explicit UNKNOWN_ACTION and 'no action' are therefore indistinguishable on the observed side; both are treated as 'not ALLOW'.
Message presence cannot be tested directly in YARA-L; presence is approximated by a disjunction of the commonly populated fields of that message (see *_PRESENT notes).

Logins without an action are FAILURES in the baseline. 'not security_result.action = "ALLOW"' returns 1632; the previous 'security_result.action != "ALLOW"' returns 0.

http: gus-sdl 2026-09-29, host MUGATU: 22 NETWORK_HTTP events with only user_agent set (no method, response_code 0). Baseline http_queries_total avg 25, success avg 25, fail avg 0. Events without a method are counted, and response_code 0 counts as success.

http: gus-sdl 2026-09-29, principal.asset.ip 172.16.2.6: 347992 NETWORK_HTTP events, 81126 with a method; baseline http_queries_total avg 82095.8. NETWORK_HTTP events with no http fields are NOT counted.
network: gus-sdl 2026-09-29: events with sent_bytes in (0, 1e15) exist under NETWORK_CONNECTION (8277832), NETWORK_HTTP (30) and STATUS_UNCATEGORIZED (3); the baseline has no event_type filter.

auth_attempts_total.baseline_sql_where: event_type = USER_LOGIN and security_result.action array is not null (always true for a present array, including empty)

auth_attempts_success.baseline_sql_where: event_type = USER_LOGIN and (UNKNOWN_ACTION in actions or ALLOW in actions)
notes: Logins whose only action is an explicit UNKNOWN_ACTION are success in the baseline but cannot be selected in UDM Search (see search_semantics).

auth_attempts_fail.baseline_sql_where: event_type = USER_LOGIN and not (UNKNOWN_ACTION in actions or ALLOW in actions); logins with no action value count as failures
notes: Replaces 'security_result.action != "ALLOW"', which drops logins that carry no action (verified live, see provenance).

dns_bytes_outbound.baseline_sql_where: sent_bytes != 0 and ((ip_protocol = UDP and target.port = 53) or (ip_protocol = TCP and target.port in (53, 3000))); no event_type filter
observed_filter: ((network.ip_protocol = "UDP" and target.port = 53) or (network.ip_protocol = "TCP" and (target.port = 53 or target.port = 3000)))

dns_queries_total.baseline_sql_where: network.dns message present (dns.id is not null); no event_type filter
notes: DNS_PRESENT approximation. On gus-sdl 2026-09-29 every NETWORK_DNS event had a question name and no other event type did.

dns_queries_success.baseline_sql_where: network.dns message present and dns.response_code = 0 (unset reads as 0)

http_queries_total.baseline_sql_where: network.http message present (http.method is not null); no event_type filter
observed_filter: (network.http.method != "" or network.http.user_agent != "" or network.http.response_code != 0 or network.http.referral_url != "")
notes: HTTP_PRESENT approximation, verified against baselines for MUGATU and 172.16.2.6 (see provenance). A method-only filter misses user-agent-only events; an event_type-only filter overcounts Zeek NETWORK_HTTP rows with no http fields.

http_queries_success.baseline_sql_where: network.http message present and response_code < 400 (unset response_code reads as 0 and counts as success)
observed_filter: (network.http.method != "" or network.http.user_agent != "" or network.http.response_code != 0 or network.http.referral_url != "")
notes: Replaces 'response_code >= 200 and < 400', which drops response_code 0 events that the baseline counts as success (verified live).

http_queries_fail.baseline_sql_where: network.http message present and (response_code >= 400 or response_code is null); the null branch cannot fire for a present proto3 message
observed_filter: (network.http.method != "" or network.http.user_agent != "" or network.http.response_code != 0 or network.http.referral_url != "")

network_bytes_outbound.baseline_sql_where: sent_bytes != 0 and sent_bytes < 1e15; no event_type filter

network_bytes_inbound.baseline_sql_where: received_bytes != 0 and received_bytes < 1e15; no event_type filter

network_bytes_total.baseline_sql_where: (received_bytes in (0, 1e15)) or (sent_bytes in (0, 1e15)); value = sent + received; no event_type filter

network_flows_outbound.baseline_sql_where: sent_bytes != 0 and sent_bytes < 1e15; counts events; no event_type filter

network_flows_inbound.baseline_sql_where: received_bytes != 0 and received_bytes < 1e15; counts events; no event_type filter

network_flows_total.baseline_sql_where: (received_bytes in (0, 1e15)) or (sent_bytes in (0, 1e15)); counts events; no event_type filter

file_executions_success.baseline_sql_where: event_type = PROCESS_LAUNCH and ALLOW in actions

file_executions_fail.baseline_sql_where: event_type = PROCESS_LAUNCH and ALLOW not in actions (includes launches with no action)

resource_creation_success.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_CREATION, USER_RESOURCE_CREATION) and (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_creation_fail.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_CREATION, USER_RESOURCE_CREATION) and not (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_deletion_success.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_DELETION, USER_RESOURCE_DELETION) and (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_deletion_fail.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_DELETION, USER_RESOURCE_DELETION) and not (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_read_success.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_READ, USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS) and (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_read_fail.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_READ, USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS) and not (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_written_success.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_WRITTEN, USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_CONTENT) and (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

resource_written_fail.baseline_sql_where: event_type in (RESOURCE_WRITTEN, USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_CONTENT) and not (UNKNOWN_ACTION or ALLOW in actions)

workspace_auth_attempts_total.baseline_sql_where: vendor_name = 'Google Workspace' and product_name in ('login', 'saml', 'token'); no event_type filter

workspace_emails_sent_total.baseline_sql_where: network message present (sent_bytes is not null) and product_name in ('GMAIL', 'gmail') (case-sensitive); no event_type filter
notes: The product_name match is case-sensitive in the baseline: gus-sdl logs 'Gmail', which the baseline does not count.
The 'network message present' condition cannot be expressed in YARA-L and is not applied.

workspace_network_bytes_outbound.baseline_sql_where: network message present and product_name in ('GMAIL', 'gmail'); value = sent_bytes

workspace_network_bytes_total.baseline_sql_where: network message present and product_name in ('GMAIL', 'gmail'); value = sent + received

workspace_total_change_actions.baseline_sql_where: vendor_name = 'Google Workspace' (every Workspace event); no event_type filter
notes: Despite the name, the baseline counts every Google Workspace event, not only change actions.

alert_event_name_count.baseline_sql_where: log_type in (CB_EDR, CS_EDR, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT, SENTINELONE_ALERTS); no event_type filter
observed_filter: (metadata.log_type = "CB_EDR" or metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" or metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERTS")
